title: Conversation response
description: The response to POST {endpoint} (201), POST {endpoint}/{id}/messages (202), POST {endpoint}/{id}/handoff (202), and POST {endpoint}/{id}/close (200). Spec sections 8.3, 8.7, 8.9, and 8.12. Every successful response includes status and responder; starting a conversation also returns conversation_id. With the wait query parameter, a POST responds as a read of events would (events-response.schema.json), which also matches this schema.
